verdicts.reason: A: the headline and the one-line subcopy read cleanly in the blue panel, but the 'Find a Fare' CTA is a tiny pill jammed into the top-left corner above the logo, which breaks the reading order. The 'UP TO 40% OFF' badge is rotated and clipped at the right edge, and almost none of the sea imagery survives. B: the red badge collides with the sunglasses on the busy photo, the white Meridian logo sits on the landscape with weak contrast, and the subcopy is squeezed into four ragged lines against the right edge, leaving the panel cramped and lopsided. A is the less broken of the two.
